versions.content: The function <Mip>_Inv_<transformerId> specified in [SWS_Xfrm_00042] shall exist for the first reference in the list of ordered references transformer from a DataTransformation to a TransformationTechnology if the DataTransformation is referenced by an DataPrototypeMapping in the role firstToSecondDataTransformation .
